Run representative-individual sensitivity analysis for population scenarios

runRepresentativeSensitivityAnalysisForScenarios.Rd

This function selects representative individuals from a scenario population based on configured PK parameters and requested quantiles, then runs the existing sensitivity workflow separately for each representative.

Usage

runRepresentativeSensitivityAnalysisForScenarios(
  projectConfiguration,
  scenarioList,
  scenarioNames = NULL,
  sensitivitysheet,
  representativeQuantiles = c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95),
  variationRange = 0.1,
  numberOfSteps = 2,
  simulationRunOptions = ospsuite::SimulationRunOptions$new(showProgress = TRUE),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

Arguments

projectConfiguration

An object representing the project configuration.

scenarioList

A named list of scenarios to analyze.

scenarioNames

A character vector of scenario names to run. Defaults to `NULL`, which analyzes all scenarios in `scenarioList`.

sensitivitysheet

The name of the sheet in the sensitivity Excel file to use for analysis.

representativeQuantiles

Numeric vector of quantiles used to select representative individuals per PK parameter and output path. Defaults to `c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95)`.

variationRange

Numeric fraction defining how much each sensitivity parameter is varied around baseline (e.g., `0.1` means +/- 10%).

numberOfSteps

Integer number of perturbation steps on each side of baseline used for sensitivity estimation.

simulationRunOptions

Optional `SimulationRunOptions` passed to the simulation runs and prerequisite scenario simulations.

overwrite

A logical indicating whether to overwrite existing results.

Value

Invisibly returns `NULL`.

Details

Ratio mode is intentionally not supported for this workflow.

See also

Other sensitivity analysis: addSensitivityTable(), runSensitivityAnalysisForScenarios()
